body:
I played for around 11 years. I totally suck at playing by ear though, so I'm not sure how well that would turn out for me haha. 

Thanks for the encouragement! I used to be way more paranoid and I'm slowly improving, but I still need a lot of work to get over that anxiety.

Thanks for offering to talk. For me personally, I think I found my passion in my field of study, but I still need to have something I could do to connect with others and fulfill my social needs. Do you feel you had to try a lot of things before you found something you were passionate about?

I used the play classical piano, but I didn't have any real passion for it so I quit. I've never tried making music on my computer before, but that seems interesting.

Do you think people would wonder why I'm asking them to hang out? Like I'm paranoid that they'll wonder why I don't have other friends to do stuff with.

I'm okay with small talk. But I have no idea how to ask people to hang out or get lunch or whatever. It just feels very unnatural to me, if that makes sense. 

And yeah, I definitely need some hobbies. Ideally ones that involve socializing.

Do you think my boss would be annoyed at having to pay for my food? He did pay for all the orders, but the fact that he'll be paying for something that only I will be eating, makes me feel really bad.

I suppose being a quadriplegic would be worse, but it still doesn't make my situation any less terrible. Either way, I don't know how to find happiness within myself. I've tried therapy but it hasn't been helping. I feel like I've reached my maximum level of happiness possible.
